title: rhinanthus asperulus subsp. rohlenae
intro: Rhinanthus asperulus subsp. rohlenae, commonly known as Rohlena's beard-tongue, is a plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rohlena's beard-tongue include treating various health conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations, due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic applications and bioactive constituents.
